parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: For each of the functions $\text{f}_2$ and $\text{f}_3$, state why it cannot be a probability density function.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The probability density function $\text{g}$ is defined by

$$\text{g}(x) = \begin{cases} 6(a^2 - x^2) & -a \leqslant x \leqslant a, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $a$ is a constant.
